subject: Security discovery — SOC 2 posture, breach notification SLOs & evidence ask
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery — SOC 2 posture, breach notification SLOs & evidence ask

Elena,

Thanks again for demoing Novus Health's use case this morning — great conversation. As we discussed, our AE team will need to complete a short security discovery to scope Dedicated/private deployment options and answer a few compliance questions for Legal/Procurement. Consolidating next steps here so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Action items for Novus Health (requested by 2026-06-14):
- Confirm current SOC 2 status (Type I/Type II, period covered) and attach the latest report or status summary.
- Confirm whether processing includes PHI (HIPAA applicability) and any existing attestation.
- Return the vendor security questionnaire we attached (see filename below).
- High-level incident response (IR) timeline: provide your SLA/expected notification windows for confirmed data breaches and a short summary of your IR playbook or where we can pull artifacts.
- Top-level BCP/DR artifacts: network diagram or recovery RTO/RPO targets (preferably the 1-page diagram).

I attached a short SR summary template for SOC 2 status and an IR-playbook extract that shows the type of evidence Legal typically requests. If anything is sensitive, feel free to send through your secure SFTP or share a limited Drive link.

Attachments: SOC2-status-summary-2026-06.pdf, IR-playbook-extract.docx, vendor-questionnaire-redwood.docx

Goal: We want enough to 1) confirm there are no hard blockers for Redwood's private deployment and 2) align on breach notification timing so we can draft the contract clause (72-hour vs 48-hour, regulatory escalation steps).

If it's helpful, we can run through the questionnaire on a quick call — happy to schedule.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novushealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com, security@novushealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery — SOC 2 posture, breach notification SLOs & evidence ask

Neha,

Appreciate the clear checklist and the template — that helps. Quick updates from our side: 

- SOC 2: We completed a SOC 2 Type I in Sept 2025; Type II is targeted for completion in Q3 2026 (audit window May–Aug). I attached a short status summary (redacted).
- HIPAA/PHI: Some patient-identifiable fields are stored in our platform for integrations. We are in process of updating our Business Associate agreements and a limited HIPAA attestation is available; full attestation scheduled post-Type II.
- IR & breach notification: Our policy requires initial internal detection confirmation within 24 hours and customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed data exfiltration. Severity-based escalations to regulators are documented; I'll include a 1-page IR summary.
- BCP/DR: I'll share a sanitized network/BCP diagram and RTO/RPO targets.

We will start filling the questionnaire this afternoon. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a notarized SOC 2 report or if a redacted PDF + auditor contact is sufficient for procurement?

Attachments: novus-ir-summary.pdf

Best,
Elena Martinez
Director of Security Operations
Novus Health
elena.martinez@novushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Security discovery — SOC 2 posture, breach notification SLOs & evidence ask

Looping internal ops and legal next steps.

Neha / Ben — please split the evidence checklist below and confirm who owns each item by EOD Thursday:
- SOC2 redacted PDF + auditor contact (Legal wants the Type II timeline for the contract) — owner: Legal (Ben)
- HIPAA attestation language (if any) and BAA template — owner: Compliance (Neha)
- IR summary + sample notification template (we want to verify the 72-hour window and the escalation path) — owner: Incident Ops (Neha)
- BCP network diagram and RTO/RPO table (sanitized) — owner: Solutions/Eng (Ben)

If Novus's IR timeline has anything longer than 72 hours to customer notification, escalate to me immediately so I can flag contract exceptions. We should also plan for a short 30-min intake call with Legal if they push a Type II-only requirement.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery — SOC 2 posture, breach notification SLOs & evidence ask

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the IR summary (appreciate the redacted artifact). Quoting your note below for clarity: 

> "Our policy requires initial internal detection confirmation within 24 hours and customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed data exfiltration. Severity-based escalations to regulators are documented; I'll include a 1-page IR summary."

That aligns with Redwood's baseline requirements. Quick confirmation and next steps: 
- Novus to upload the SOC 2 redacted PDF + auditor contact OR provide temporary secure share by 2026-06-14. (Procurement note: a redacted PDF + auditor contact is acceptable for initial review; Legal will request the full report once deal advances.)
- Novus to complete the attached vendor_questionnaire and return the signed copy by 2026-06-14 (vendor-questionnaire-redwood.docx).
- Novus to share sanitized BCP diagram and RTO/RPO targets (BCP-network-diagrams.pdf preferred).
- Redwood will provision a short intake with Legal only if Type II is required by Legal after they see the redacted report.

I'll drop these items into the HubSpot deal and share a Drive folder for secure upload. Link below for convenience. If Novus would rather a short walk-through to fill the questionnaire together, propose 30 minutes next week and we'll have Ben join for the BCP questions.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/55555/NH-2026-147
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novus-security-pack

Thanks all — we'll check back on 2026-06-14.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
